_about: The only checkpoint, LoRAs and ControlNet models a Forge job may use. forge_jobs.py checks every job against this list and against what Forge has installed. Only Josh adds to it.

checkpoints.indigoVoidFurryFusedXL_noobaiV35_fp16.sa: The required model for every character.

charsheet_lora_v1.use: Only for character sheet requests (front, side and back views on one sheet). Put the trigger word in the prompt.

controlnet.diffusion_pytorch_model_V2: Canny / edge guide: locks outline, pose and layout to a guide image.
controlnet.ip-adapter-plus_sdxl_vit-h: Reference image (module CLIP-ViT-H (IPAdapter)): carries a character's look and colours over without copying the layout.
